author: Unfiltered
text:
THE PHONE SETTINGS THAT ACTUALLY CHANGE YOUR LIFE:

- Grayscale mode
- Notifications off for social apps
- Do not disturb after 9pm
- Screen time limits
- Auto lock under 30 seconds
- App limits on scrolling apps
- Focus mode for work hours
- Airplane mode while sleeping
- Badge icons turned off
- Home screen with no social apps
- Silent mode during deep work
- Location sharing turned off by default

Your phone should work for you, not the other way around.

topReplies.author: Hetall Dev
topReplies.text: Your phone should serve your life, not steal your attention.
